closed_supplemental_findings.title: Confidence-only downgrade still bypasses reliable normal controls
closed_supplemental_findings.reproduction: Replace every extracted observation's confidence with 0.50 while preserving capability, quality issues, field values and evidence. run_fixed_regression returns passed=true, normal preserved=98/98 and routed=0.
closed_supplemental_findings.consequence: apps/processing/pipeline.py persists this value as SourceEvidence.confidence; readmodels hides values below 0.80 and validation routes confidence below 0.95 to recognition_uncertain. The gate therefore still permits a change that removes all reliable controls from their intended use.

closed_supplemental_findings.title: A zero-row incomplete report is ignored when marking a shared file page complete
closed_supplemental_findings.reproduction: The same source file declares report_group_ids g1 and g3. g1 has a complete annotated row on page 1; g3 is explicitly incomplete and has no annotation rows. An output on page 1 from unannotated g3 is counted FP=1 and severe error=1, with unassessed_prediction_rows=0, because complete_pages is built only from groups already present in gold rows.
closed_supplemental_findings.consequence: A partially annotated mixed/bundled source can still be treated as fully annotated merely because its completed report has rows on that page.
closed_supplemental_findings.recommendation: Use an independent complete page-to-report mapping, or conservatively leave unmatched rows unassessed when the file includes unlocated/incomplete report groups.
closed_supplemental_findings.closeout_evidence: Independently declared a complete g1 and a zero-row incomplete g3 in the same source file, then added an unannotated g3 prediction on page 1. The report now returns joint TP=1, FP=0, unassessed_prediction_rows=1 and severe errors=0.
